financialMap.title: How your financial system works
financialMap.subtitle: Follow the tree from setup to entry, posting, ledger truth, and the results you use to run the business.

setup.title: Set up the financial foundation
setup.body: Your organization creates the secure boundary and base currency. Build the accounts your business needs, then record the first real business event.
setup.accountsHint: Where debit and credit lines land
setup.categoriesHint: Friendly labels mapped to ledger accounts

financialMap.sourcesTitle: Three paths can request a posting
financialMap.sourcesHint: They collect business details differently, but none can bypass the same accounting rules.

manual.title: Manual transaction
manual.body: Choose what happened; Ledger Suit derives the debit and credit accounts for you.
manual.flowsTitle: Choose the kind of manual entry

commitments.title: Commitment
commitments.body: Tracks money due to you or owed by you, with due dates, reminders, partial settlement, postponement, and cancellation.
commitments.rule: Outside the ledger until it is settled or automatically converted.

recurring.title: Recurring rule
recurring.body: Creates unique scheduled occurrences from a reusable income, expense, or liability-payment template.
recurring.rule: Reaches the ledger only after confirmation or a successful automatic post.

engine.title: Protected posting engine
engine.body: One controlled database transaction either posts the complete journal or posts nothing.
engine.result: Checks passed — the complete journal can now be posted

checks.access: Membership, capability, and subscription allow the action
checks.period: The accounting date is not in a locked period
checks.accounts: Every account is active and belongs to this organization
checks.balance: Currency amounts are valid and total debits equal credits
checks.atomic: Transaction, lines, and audit record succeed together

ledger.eventHint: What happened, when, reference, source, and counterparty.
ledger.linesHint: At least two immutable lines, stored in transaction and base currency.
ledger.rule: Posted entries are the single source of truth · Debits always equal credits

financialMap.resultsFrom: Every result is derived from posted entries
financialMap.resultsHint: Drafts, unsettled commitments, and unposted schedules do not change any official figure.

accounts.title: Account balances
accounts.body: Live balances and entry counts are calculated from ledger lines. No separate stored balance can drift.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.body: Assets, liabilities, net worth, cash, revenue, expenses, profit, and recent activity.

reports.title: Financial reports
reports.body: Official views aggregate only posted ledger entries for the selected date or period.

audit.title: Audit and corrections
audit.body: Posted history is immutable. A correction creates a mirrored reversal, then a corrected transaction; the original remains visible.

boundary.title: Context, not balances:
boundary.body: Counterparties explain who was involved; tags organize analysis; attachments preserve evidence. They enrich a transaction but never change its accounting amounts.

landing.title: Business finance, clearly managed
landing.heroTitle: Run your finances from one calm, accurate workspace.

landing.trialNote: 14 days free · No credit card required

cashflow.title: Cash visibility

ledger.title: Controlled accounting
ledger.body: Atomic double-entry posting keeps every journal balanced and auditable.

commitments.title: Commitments
commitments.body: Track receivables, payables, due dates, partial settlements, and overdue items.

automation.title: Recurring automation
automation.body: Schedule repeat activity while keeping review and posting controls.

reports.title: Decision-ready reports

team.title: Secure collaboration
